items.label: U.S. House
items.text: U.S. Representative for California's 16th Congressional District since 2025. (sources: Voteview (UCLA) https://voteview.com/person/22532/sam-t-liccardo [search summary, secondary]; Ballotpedia https://ballotpedia.org/Sam_Liccardo [search summary, secondary])

items.label: San Jose
items.text: Mayor of San Jose, 2015 to 2023 (Ballotpedia lists 2015 to 2022). Member of the San Jose City Council, 2007 to 2015 per a Biographical Directory entry; another source says he was elected to the council in 2006. (sources: Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sam_Liccardo [search summary, secondary]; Ballotpedia https://ballotpedia.org/Sam_Liccardo [search summary, secondary]; Voteview (UCLA) https://voteview.com/person/22532/sam-t-liccardo [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Prosecutor
items.text: Before his 2006 election to public office, worked as a criminal prosecutor in the Santa Clara County District Attorney's Office; some accounts also describe work as a federal prosecutor. (sources: Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sam_Liccardo [search summary, secondary]; San Jose Inside https://sanjoseinside.com/politics/3_14_12_sam_liccardo_mayor_city_council_district_attrorney_downtown [search summary, secondary])

items.label: Education
items.text: Graduated from Bellarmine College Preparatory, San Jose, 1987; B.A., government, Georgetown University; J.D., Harvard Law School; M.P.P., Harvard Kennedy School. (sources: Legilist (reproduces Biographical Directory text) https://legilist.com/legislator/L000607 [search summary, secondary]; Wikipedia https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Sam_Liccardo [search summary, secondary]; Ballotpedia https://ballotpedia.org/Sam_Liccardo [search summary, secondary])
